messages:
anya: Heads-up team 1: final sanity check for Thursday's public announce. Need: prod changelog anchor, CDN benchmark image, sales webhook auth, and rollout timing.

sophie: I'm finishing the changelog now. Will include the exact anchor to the fallback section and push to prod by tomorrow morning. Draft PR: github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pulls/499 (WIP).

kiran: Sales webhook details: POST to https://hooks.sales.redwood.ai/announce with X-Sales-Signature HMAC. Sales-bot did a test earlier but wants confirmation from ops.

ops-bot: Deploy window: canary 2026-03-26T09:50-07:00 full 2026-03-26T10:00-07:00. Healthcheck endpoint /v1/announce/health will be polled at T-2m and T+1m.

anya: CDN image for marketing hero should be prod only. I uploaded bench image: https://cdn.redwood.ai/assets/releases/26mar/bench-wide.png (alt: "Latency & cost per 1k tokens, Mar 2026"). Use that.

sophie: Changelog short line for social: "Faster & cheaper inference: adaptive batching tuned; graceful quantized fallback; streaming stability fixes." Keep that for tweet thread.

kiran: Lead routing rules: if employee_count >= 500 => sales-enterprise; else if employee_count between 50-499 => saas-growth; else => nurture. Sales-bot: confirm webhook mapping.

sales-bot: Mapping confirmed. Test payload returned route:sales-enterprise for sample corp payload. Auth header validated.

ops-bot: Healthcheck @ T-30m: 200 OK, p95 41ms. No issues. Rollback policy: revert canary if 5xx > 1% for 2m.

anya: Okay locking announce at 09:55 PT, webinar email at 10:00 PT. Sophie, paste final prod changelog anchor here when ready. Kiran, please confirm sales will pick up leads within 1 hour.

sophie: Changelog merged. Prod anchor: https://docs.redwood.ai/release/2026-03-26#rollout-fallbacks

kiran: Sales confirmed SLA: first-touch email within 1 hour. UTM params set utm_campaign=announce-2026-03-26.

anya: :thumbsup: Thanks all. I'll post final assets and copy to #marketing-announce T-10m before publish. Ops, please post a final healthcheck at T-2m.

ops-bot: Will post healthcheck at T-2m.
